== Navigation ==
=== Directions ===
To better understand direction codes (bearings):<br>
* Open your GPS '''[Right Ctrl+M]''' or compass '''[2xK]'''.<br>
The direction matches the 360° system. North is marked as 000, East as 090 and so on. Coordinates are also visible on the map.

''Clock position is often used for a relative direction. Based on a 12-hour clock analogy, 12 o'clock means directly ahead, 3 o'clock means right and so on. When you receive such information, a simple clock icon appears.''


=== Map ===
The map is a powerful tool for navigation and commanding.<br>
* Open it by pressing '''[M]'''.<br>
* Zoom the map in or out with '''[mouse-wheel up and down]'''.<br>
* Try hiding or showing map '''textures''' or centering on your position. Buttons are located on the top toolbar.<br>
* Close the map by pressing '''[M]''' or '''[Esc]'''.

''Remember, you can only see the map if you have a GPS or Map in your Inventory.''


=== Tasks ===
You have a new task. Tasks are mission objectives received from Command. To open mission tasks:<br>
* Open the task list '''[J]'''.<br>
Alternatively, you can access your tasks on the map.<br>
* Open the map '''[M]''' and select '''Tasks'''.

''Goals from the active task are marked on your screen. To select a different task as active:<br>
* Open tasks '''[J]'''.<br>
* Click on the task.<br>
* Then click on '''set as an active task'''.''


=== Waypoints ===
Waypoints mark a location you are ordered to go to by your team-leader or a task. All waypoints and go-to orders will be shown by a marker on the screen. When moving in a formation, a formation marker will also be shown on the screen, but without any distance and description.

''Task related waypoints [[File:a3_fm_taskicon.png|24px]] are shown on the map. The displaying of waypoints depends on difficulty settings chosen.''


=== Custom Waypoints ===
You can add a custom waypoint to a map. It will be displayed both on the map and in the scene. To add a waypoint<br>
* Open the map by '''[M]'''.<br>
* Place the waypoint with '''[Left Shift]'''+'''[LMB]'''.
